name: resume-grill
description: Resume-based interview prep in four modes: grill a resume into a per-candidate interviewer kit (briefing, deep questions with what to listen for and folded model answers, scoring and a review draft), weakness analysis, resume optimization without invented facts, and job-description match; every result is a self-contained HTML page that exports to PDF. 简历拷打：面试拷打（每位候选人一份面试官手册）、弱点分析、简历优化、JD匹配四种模式，一句话启动，产物为可导出PDF的HTML。
